name: Semantic Version Bumper

# Runs on every push, and can be triggered manually. The version-bump job
# exercises the bumper against mock commit-log fixtures with known expected
# results, so CI both tests the tool and demonstrates it end-to-end.
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

# The workflow only reads the repo; it never pushes tags or commits.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Deterministic changelog dates so output can be asserted exactly.
  RELEASE_DATE: "2026-07-01"

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit tests (bun test)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Run test suite
        run: bun test

  version-bump:
    name: "Bump: ${{ matrix.name }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit-tests
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Each case: a commit-log fixture, a starting version, and the
          # exact version the bumper must produce.
          - name: feat
            fixture: commits-feat.txt
            start: "1.2.3"
            expected: "1.3.0"
          - name: fix
            fixture: commits-fix.txt
            start: "1.2.3"
            expected: "1.2.4"
          - name: breaking
            fixture: commits-breaking.txt
            start: "1.2.3"
            expected: "2.0.0"
          - name: none
            fixture: commits-none.txt
            start: "1.2.3"
            expected: "1.2.3"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Bump version from fixture commits
        shell: bash
        env:
          CASE_NAME: ${{ matrix.name }}
          FIXTURE: ${{ matrix.fixture }}
          START_VERSION: ${{ matrix.start }}
          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ matrix.expected }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Seed a scratch project with the starting version + fixture log.
          work="$(mktemp -d)"
          printf '{\n  "name": "demo-app",\n  "version": "%s"\n}\n' "$START_VERSION" > "$work/package.json"
          cp "fixtures/$FIXTURE" "$work/commits.txt"

          # Run the bumper.
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --version-file "$work/package.json" \
            --commits "$work/commits.txt" \
            --changelog "$work/CHANGELOG.md" \
            --date "$RELEASE_DATE"

          # Read back the version actually written and assert exact equality.
          actual="$(bun -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')).version)" "$work/package.json")"
          echo "RESULT case=$CASE_NAME version=$actual"
          if [ "$actual" != "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: case $CASE_NAME expected $EXPECTED_VERSION but got $actual"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Show the generated changelog entry (bump cases only).
          if [ -f "$work/CHANGELOG.md" ]; then
            echo "--- CHANGELOG ($CASE_NAME) ---"
            cat "$work/CHANGELOG.md"
            echo "--- END CHANGELOG ($CASE_NAME) ---"
          fi

input.content:
# semantic-version-bumper

Bumps a semantic version based on conventional commits and generates a
changelog entry. Built with TypeScript + Bun using red/green TDD.

Rules: any breaking change (`type!:` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer) → major,
else any `feat` → minor, else any `fix` → patch, else no bump.

## Usage

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts \
  --version-file package.json \   # or a plain VERSION file
  --commits commits.txt \         # one commit subject per line (git log --pretty=%s)
  --changelog CHANGELOG.md \
  --date 2026-07-01 \             # optional, defaults to today
  --dry-run                       # optional, compute only
```

The new version is printed as the last line of stdout. With no releasable
commits the version file is left untouched and the CLI exits 0.

## Layout

- `src/semver.ts` — parse/format/bump `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
- `src/commits.ts` — conventional-commit parsing + bump decision
- `src/changelog.ts` — markdown changelog entry generation/prepending
- `src/versionfile.ts` — read/write package.json or plain VERSION files
- `src/cli.ts` — command-line entry point
- `fixtures/` — mock commit logs used by both unit tests and CI
- `tests/` — `bun test` suite (unit, CLI subprocess, workflow structure)
- `scripts/run-act-tests.ts` — runs every fixture case through the GitHub
  Actions workflow with `act` and asserts exact expected versions

## Testing

```sh
bun test                          # unit + CLI + workflow-structure tests
bun run scripts/run-act-tests.ts  # full pipeline via act (writes act-result.txt)
```

The workflow at `.github/workflows/semantic-version-bumper.yml` runs the unit
tests, then a matrix job per fixture case (feat → 1.3.0, fix → 1.2.4,
breaking → 2.0.0, none → unchanged) asserting exact results.
